_about: Learning-plan settings (pathway.md §4). Every value is a DECLARED design choice from the spec, not fitted to data. Budget limit and timeframe weeks come from questionnaire.json and scoring.json so they exist once. max_overshoot: a course longer than this multiple of the gap's estimated hours is chosen only when no shorter course covers the skill (it stays a Swap alternative). score.employer_funded (team decision 2026-10-23): an HRD-claimable course gets this bonus for someone employed who chose the budget 'Any, if my employer pays' and whose employer is HRD-registered or who is not sure, so employer-funded training is preferred as they asked; it is larger than free (3) + self-paced (0.5) + shorter (1) so it also wins at its listed price.
